topic: Free Stanford and Google AI certifications
angle: The best AI courses cost nothing and nobody finishes them
hook: Stanford and Google will teach you AI for free
caption:
The paid AI course market exists because people do not know the free ones are there. Stanford publishes its lectures. Google runs a certificate track. Neither costs anything and both are better than most of what gets sold on Instagram. The hard part was never access — it is finishing.

💬 Comment "LEARN" and I'll send you the full list.
🔖 Save this for the next time you need it.
➡️ Follow @profit_prompts_ for the AI stack that actually pays.

#aicourses #freelearning #stanford #google #upskilling #careergrowth

slides.text: Stanford and Google will teach you AI for *free*
slides.subline: Full courses, real certificates, zero cost

slides.text: People sell AI courses for money because most people never check what the universities already gave away.

slides.title: Start with the lectures
slides.body: Stanford puts full course lectures online with no signup. Same material the degree students get. Watch at double speed and you have covered a term in a fortnight.

slides.caption: the actual cost of the best AI course you can take right now

slides.title: Then get the certificate
slides.body: Google's certificate track is structured and gives you something to put on a profile. Recruiters recognise it. It matters more than the twelve-hour course somebody sold you.

slides.title: Finish one, not five
slides.body: Everyone enrols in four courses and completes none. Pick a single track, block two hours on the same two evenings each week, and do not start another until it is done.

slides.text: Save this before you need it
slides.subline: Send it to someone still paying for this
